name: meshwork
description: Network toolkit for on-site work: discover, inventory, map and diagnose networks.
author: Influx Network LLC

scripts.verify: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.dist:win: node scripts/collect-licenses.mjs && electron-vite build && electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.config.cjs --publish never && node scripts/remove-unpacked.mjs
scripts.dist:mac: node scripts/build-wifi-helper.mjs && node scripts/collect-licenses.mjs && electron-vite build && bash scripts/release-env.sh electron-builder --mac --config electron-builder.config.cjs --publish never && node scripts/remove-unpacked.mjs
scripts.dist:mas: node scripts/build-wifi-helper.mjs && node scripts/build-net-helper.mjs && node scripts/collect-licenses.mjs && electron-vite build && bash scripts/release-env.sh electron-builder --mac mas --universal --config electron-builder.mas.config.cjs --publish never
